objects.name: POLONIUM
objects.description: [POLONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1005) is a Lebanon-based group that has primarily targeted Israeli organizations, including critical manufacturing, information technology, and defense industry companies, since at least February 2022. Security researchers assess [POLONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1005) has coordinated their operations with multiple actors affiliated with Iran’s Ministry of Intelligence and Security (MOIS), based on victim overlap as well as common techniques and tooling.(Citation: Microsoft POLONIUM June 2022)

objects.description_fa: [POLONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1005) یک گروه مستقر در لبنان است که اساساً سازمان‌های اسرائیلی، از جمله شرکت‌های مهم تولیدی، فناوری اطلاعات و صنایع دفاعی را از فوریه ۲۰۲۲ هدف قرار داده است. وزارت اطلاعات و امنیت (MOIS)، بر اساس همپوشانی قربانیان و همچنین تکنیک‌ها و ابزارهای رایج.(Citation: Microsoft POLONIUM June 2022)
